<Heading
  as={"h1"}
  className={"openapi__heading"}
  children={"Extract objects from image"}
></Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/aivision/objectsExtraction"}
  context={"endpoint"}
></MethodEndpoint>

Extract objects from an image using either bounding boxes or point selection.
Supports both object extraction (with bounding boxes) and object segmentation (with points).

<Heading
  id={"request"}
  as={"h2"}
  className={"openapi-tabs__heading"}
  children={"Request"}
></Heading>

<ParamsDetails parameters={undefined}></ParamsDetails>

<RequestSchema
  title={"Body"}
  body={{
    required: true,
    content: {
      "multipart/form-data": {
        schema: {
          type: "object",
          properties: {
            file: {
              type: "string",
              format: "binary",
              description: "Image file to process (JPEG, PNG, WebP, max 35MB)",
            },
            bboxes: {
              type: "string",
              description:
                'JSON array of bounding boxes for object extraction.\nFormat: [{"startX": 0, "startY": 0, "endX": 100, "endY": 100}]\n',
            },
            points: {
              type: "string",
              description:
                'JSON object with positive and negative points for segmentation.\nFormat: {"positive": [{"x": 100, "y": 100}], "negative": [{"x": 0, "y": 0}]}\n',
            },
          },
          required: ["file"],
          oneOf: [{ required: ["bboxes"] }, { required: ["points"] }],
        },
        examples: {
          bounding_boxes: {
            summary: "Extract using bounding boxes",
            description:
              "Extract objects using precise bounding box coordinates",
            value: {
              file: "scene.jpg",
              bboxes:
                '[{"startX": 100, "startY": 150, "endX": 300, "endY": 400}, {"startX": 500, "startY": 200, "endX": 700, "endY": 450}]',
            },
          },
          single_object: {
            summary: "Extract single object with bounding box",
            description: "Extract one object using a single bounding box",
            value: {
              file: "portrait.jpg",
              bboxes:
                '[{"startX": 50, "startY": 50, "endX": 250, "endY": 350}]',
            },
          },
          points_segmentation: {
            summary: "Extract using points",
            description: "Use point selection for precise object segmentation",
            value: {
              file: "complex_scene.jpg",
              points:
                '{"positive": [{"x": 150, "y": 200}, {"x": 160, "y": 210}], "negative": [{"x": 0, "y": 0}, {"x": 800, "y": 600}]}',
            },
          },
        },
      },
    },
  }}
></RequestSchema>
